title: Signals Alongside Scans: A Genomics-Guided Framework for Liquid Biopsy in Bone and Soft-Tissue Sarcomas.
snippet: Bone and soft-tissue sarcomas are rare, heterogeneous malignancies whose surveillance remains dominated by imaging despite substantial molecular diversity and variable patterns of relapse. title: Tumoral Metabolism at the Intersection of Oncogene Signaling, Epigenetics and Immunology: Emerging Therapeutic Strategies in Cancer.
